scenes.title: Sealed File
narration: *Devgadh court ka chamber block raat ke baarish se sookha nahi hai. Corridor ki tube light beech-beech mein flicker karti hai, aur ek chamber ke darwaze par lagayi sealing tape abhi tak chipki hui hai.*

*Tum apni table par ho, aadhi khuli files aur ek thanda chai ka cup saamne. Advocate Meera Deshmukh darwaze par khadi hai — long wavy hair ek kandhe par, charcoal blazer par baarish ki boondein, haath mein ek slim case file dabaye hue.*
*Wo file tumhari table par rakhti hai, par haath hataati nahi. Uske andar 2019 ki closure file hai, aur usi ke beech mein ek statement — signed aur dated 2024.*
Meera: "File kehti hai woh 2019 mein mar chuka tha. Statement 2024 ka hai. Tum batao — kaun jhooth bol raha hai, kagaz ya aadmi?"
*Peeche record room ka clerk Nadeem Sethi chashma maathe par sarakta hua andar aata hai. Usne sign-out register khola hai aur page par ungli rakhi hai, jaise jawab wahin likha ho.*
Nadeem: "Yeh page mera haath ka nahi hai. Maine jo file 2019 mein sign-out ki thi, usme yeh kabhi nahi tha."
*Meera tumhara jawab sune bina file wapas nahi kheenchti. Baarish khatam ho rahi hai; ab pehla step tumhare haath mein hai.*
fallbackLines: *File ki sealing tape table par halki chamakti hai. Meera apni position nahi badalti; Nadeem register band nahi karta, bas uske kinare ko seedha karta hai.*
*Koi naya document apne aap saamne nahi aata. Jo asli hai aur jo likha hua hai, farq wahin se shuru hoga — tumhare pehle sawaal se.*

choices.text: "Pehle file poori kholte hain. Main har page ka date likhna chahta hoon."

memory: {{playerName}} proposed opening the full file and recording the date on every page before drawing conclusions.

choices.text: "Nadeem, register dikhao — file kisne sign-out ki, kab, aur uske baad kaun aaya?"

memory: {{playerName}} asked Nadeem Sethi to show the sign-out register and account for who handled the file and when.

choices.text: "Meera, yeh file tumhe kaise mili — aur tum isko kyun re-open karna chahti ho?"

memory: {{playerName}} asked Meera how she obtained the sealed file and why she wants the case reopened.

choices.text: "Statement pe sign karne wala aadmi zinda hai ya nahi — pehle wahi verify karna hoga."

memory: {{playerName}} insisted on verifying whether the person who signed the 2024 statement is alive before trusting any paper.
